result.comment: PI LISTS-001. Membership of a canonical prospect in a prospect list. Removal is soft. Deleting the canonical_leads row CASCADEs, but PERSON ERASURE does not reach this table — it deletes unified_persons and only nulls canonical_leads.unified_person_id; erasure cleanup is an open policy decision and is NOT implemented. Nothing here may write a canonical attribute. One prospect may belong to many lists.

constraints.name: prospect_list_members_added_by_user_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (added_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: prospect_list_members_list_fk
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (list_id, organization_id) REFERENCES prospect_lists(id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: prospect_list_members_organization_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: prospect_list_members_prospect_fk
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (prospect_id, organization_id) REFERENCES canonical_leads(id, company_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: prospect_list_members_removal_coherent
constraints.def: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (removed_at IS NULL) AND (removed_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (removal_reason IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'removed'::text) AND (removed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: prospect_list_members_removed_by_user_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (removed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
